cases.message: I spent the evening on the permissions model and here is where I landed. There are three roles: owner, editor and viewer. An owner can invite and remove people and can delete the workspace; nobody else can. An editor can change documents but cannot share them outside the workspace, because the last leak came from an editor's share link. A viewer can read and comment, and a comment never changes a document. A person has exactly one role per workspace. When an owner leaves, the oldest editor becomes owner, so that a workspace is never without one. I do not want role inheritance between workspaces: we tried it in the old product and nobody could tell who could see what.

cases.message: Here is how refunds should work; I went through last quarter's tickets to get this right. A refund can be full or partial. A full refund cancels the order and returns the stock. A partial refund keeps the order open and returns nothing to stock, because in every ticket I read the customer kept the goods. Support can refund up to 50 euros alone; above that a lead approves, and the lead cannot be the person who took the order. We never refund to a different card than the one that paid: that rule comes from the fraud team and it has no exceptions.
